The '''''Choora''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Nami]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
After learning of a [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] attempt of the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|chief scientist]] of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] project by the [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]], Nami [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]] sought to [[Battle of Kiilimaar|capture]] the scientist as she had one of the Defender prototypes to accelerate her plans to construct her own. She sent a strike force consisting of the ''Choora'' some [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] which came by the time the Empire had defeated the Rneekii pirates and recovered both the scientist and the ransom. Although the strike team managed to disable the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] [[Red Claw]], they were thwarted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and the ''Choora'' was disabled and captured. Although Tarrak was not on board the crew did provide some information about her.
